turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Now, Your Majesty, I suppose you wish me to unravel the tangled threads of this scandal?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: May I be so bold, Your Majesty, as to ask how you came to be in need of our assistance?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear for my throne, gentlemen. My situation is most precarious.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that your situation does seem precarious indeed, but I must insist that you tell me more about these 'tangled threads' that threaten your throne.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must say that I'm intrigued by your predicament. Might I suggest that you reveal more about the nature of these threats to your throne?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear, gentlemen, that I must tread with caution, lest my words betray my true identity and imperil my kingdom even further.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Come now, Your Majesty, let us dispense with the theatrics and get to the heart of the matter. I am not one for idle speculation, and I require a clear and concise account of your predicament.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must agree with Mr. Holmes, Your Majesty. It would be most helpful if you could provide us with a clear understanding of the circumstances threatening your throne.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that the burden of my position weighs heavily upon me, and I fear that I am not adequately prepared to navigate the treacherous waters that lie ahead.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us proceed with the facts, Your Majesty. I require a detailed account of the alleged threats to your throne, including the nature of the individuals involved and the specific actions they have taken.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must insist that we proceed with all due haste, Your Majesty, as the safety of your kingdom may depend on our ability to intervene in a timely manner.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am torn, gentlemen, between my duty to my kingdom and the danger that lurks in the shadows, threatening to destroy all that I hold dear. The fate of my throne hangs precariously in the balance, and I fear that I may soon be powerless to prevent the catastrophe that looms before me.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist that you, Your Majesty, provide me with a more specific description of these threats and the individuals involved, for I fear that we are wasting precious time on generalities.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must agree with Mr. Holmes, Your Majesty. The sooner we have all the facts, the better equipped we shall be to offer you our assistance.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that if I reveal too much, I may inadvertently compromise my own position, and the safety of my kingdom may be placed in greater jeopardy.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I'm not interested in vague threats, Your Majesty. I require concrete details, names, and dates. Provide me with something tangible, or I'm afraid I shall be unable to assist you.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I find your reluctance to share more information quite puzzling. Surely, if you are as concerned as you say, you would wish to entrust us with as much information as possible, so that we may better understand the nature of the threat you face.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I confess, gentlemen, that I find myself in a precarious position, and the weight of my responsibilities threatens to consume me. I am torn between the need for your assistance and the fear of compromising my own secrets.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I've heard enough of your vagueness, Your Majesty. Now, I demand to know the name of the woman who has somehow become entangled in your affairs.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must insist that you, Sherlock, allow the King to share more information before you demand such specific details. It's not that I don't trust your abilities, but surely there must be a way to proceed with caution, lest we inadvertently worsen the situation.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
